title: A sound sequence: data/sound/sequences/<category>/<name>/data.json
description: A sequence's info record in the sound archive (swan_sound_data.sdat), which tools/data/sound_data.py packs in the order of data/constants/sound.txt. Its file is sequence.sseq beside it, unless file names the sequence whose file it plays.

file.description: The sequence whose file this one plays, when it has none of its own

bank.description: The bank of instruments it plays

channel_priority.description: Its channels' priority against other sequences'
